title: Support contained in a punctured set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\iota$ be a type with decidable equality, choose $z\in\iota$, and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\iota$. For any position $i$, the set of positions $j$ for which $a(j)\ne z$ is contained in all positions except $i$ if and only if $a(i)=z$.
